title: Chocolate covered raisins recalled because they contain peanuts
summary:
Lehi Valley Trading Company of Mesa, AZ, is recalling 624 units of its 15-ounce packages of High Valley Orchard chocolate covered raisins because they contain undeclared peanuts. 

People who have allergies to peanuts run the risk of serious or life-threatening allergic reaction if they consume this product.

title: USDA issues warning about chicken wraps contaminated with Listeria
summary:
The USDA’s Food Safety and Inspection Service (FSIS) is issuing a public health alert for ready-to-eat chicken Caesar wraps because tests of the product showed contamination with Listeria monocytogenes. 

A recall was not requested because the products are no longer available for purchase.
